digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage LLM error handling
propositions: Three defensive exception handlers that decide whether LLM-tier failures abort or degrade have no test coverage reaching them: two in gate_dispatch (mid-run failure handling around run_workflow) and one in container_stage (warm-call abort).

The plan-review mid-run arm is reachable in production via the batch-step path where batch-runner exceptions propagate raw out of run_workflow; the code-review arm is a defensive seam contract where systemic errors are translated and absorbed upstream.

The container warm-call abort arm is reachable directly when pass1_container raises LLMUnavailableError or LLMInputRejectedError during the initial model invocation with sufficient container utilization.
Each arm must degrade to INDETERMINATE verdict with emitted gate_error sidecar (for mid-run) or abort with exactly one model call (for warm abort), not degrade to fan-out on systemic LLM errors.

Mutation testing confirms both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError handlers are active: reverting arms to pre-43d4 form or narrowing exception types causes test failures on input-rejected cases.
